subject: session: fix bootstrap panic when upgrading to master (#56517)
summary: The change is pure context plumbing: it stops using `session.currentCtx` (documented as trace-only and unset during bootstrap) and instead threads an explicit non-nil `context.Context` into `InfoSchema.TableByID` callsites (bootstrap partition rebuild, placement-policy pre-commit check, and write-conflict message polishing). This prevents the nil-context panic path in infoschema v2 where `TableByID` dereferences `ctx.Value(...)` during bootstrap/upgrade; no Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, privilege, or session/txn behavior for the touched code.
